candidate_binding.detail: v5 custody code binds the source v3/source-file v3 manifests, changed paths, both implementation seals, build receipt, candidate output SHA/bytes, and passing implementation/build review rows. Current 924-entry re-read and bytes/mode/SHA audit had zero failures.

formal_only_reuse_synthetic.detail: capture_sequence with aa_packets supplied and no-op real runner returned capture_complete and a 24-packet synthetic manifest, but all 24 reused A/A packet paths under the new output root were absent; real case is 576 missing A/A packet paths.

reducer_static_aa_binding.detail: reduce_capture calls check_plan/load_packets/validate_go/reduce_aa_packets but never load_bound_aa or an equivalent comparison; capture manifest plan is optional. Thus terminal reduction can accept a different valid A/A packet set than the plan-bound receipt/manifest.

terminal_and_source_packet_checks.detail: check_packet rejects nonzero exit, timeout, launch error, validation_error, binary path/SHA drift, context source-manifest SHA drift, fixture drift, malformed reports, failed correctness/oracle fields, and sample-index mutations.

v4_aa_schema_compatibility.detail: v5 accepts runner.v4 and aa_readiness.v4 packet/receipt schemas; a synthetic v4 packet/receipt normalization reduced to an equivalent v5 pass receipt. Final admission must still bind the exact sealed v4 plan hash below; generic legacy status acceptance is underconstrained.

xls_status_contract_synthetic.detail: prepare_plan.receipt_binding accepts existing helper seal status pass_external_helper_no_workload and forged status pass_forged, but rejects a schema-valid xls decision status regression_guard_pass. This is opposite of the helper output contract.

findings.impact: Every normal formal-only output is unreducible as captured: load_packets reports missing A/A JSON and reducer returns incomplete despite a passing bound A/A gate. It also breaks the stated terminal custody packet set.
findings.observed: --formal-only loads bound A/A packet objects, passes them to capture_sequence, and writes a new capture manifest whose packet_path(output_root, packet) entries are never written. Synthetic replay produced zero A/A packet files at those manifest paths.
findings.required_before_formal_plan_or_launch: Materialize exact reused packet JSON under the new output root, or make the manifest retain the bound A/A packet paths with an explicit immutable binding and teach reducer to consume them. Preserve raw sidecar custody and exclusive writes.

findings.impact: The plan can bind helper readiness as if it were a measured aggregate veto, while a real guard decision cannot be admitted. No XLS improvement gate should be added: the guard is a safety/regression veto only.
findings.observed: v5 uses generic status.startswith("pass"). The existing helper seal passes this test although it records only helper tests/no timing; the actual guard output schema status is regression_guard_pass, which v5 rejects. A forged status-only JSON also passes. The guard design explicitly returns guard_only, candidate_adoption:null, performance_claim:false.
findings.required_before_formal_plan_or_launch: Add a specialized XLS decision validator requiring schema litchi.performance.0969.xls_regression.decision.v1, status regression_guard_pass, interpretation guard_only, candidate_adoption null, performance_claim false, complete all-case A/A/formal sections and fixed <=1.05 custody result. Reject rejected/uninterpretable/incomplete. Keep benefit/improvement absent or explicitly false.

findings.impact: Offline reduction is not an independent terminal custody check: an alternate valid A/A set could be substituted while retaining the plan-bound receipt. Missing manifest plan is also silently accepted.
findings.observed: Runner formal-only has load_bound_aa, which validates the exact bound A/A receipt/manifest and reduction; reducer terminal path does not call it or compare capture-manifest A/A packet paths/reduction to those bindings. manifest.plan is optional at lines 89-91.
findings.required_before_formal_admission: Require manifest.plan path equality and exact bound A/A packet identity/reduction equality (or share load_bound_aa logic in common) before reducing formal packets. Any mismatch must be incomplete/no decision.

findings.impact: A generic authorized legacy plan could satisfy the v4 handoff label without being the reviewed sealed A/A plan.
findings.observed: v5 accepts any plan.v4/v5 file with status aa_authorized and only checks packet count/duplicates in its manifest; it does not require the sealed historical v4 plan hash or compare its source/binary/schedule fields to the formal plan.
findings.required_before_formal_plan: Bind exact `/home/zhuhe/litchi-performance-0969/plans/plan-0969-aa-v6.json` SHA e853030180d7464c06cf1ed5d525957ce2d50514b8337a1b168392374d00b5df, or independently validate all legacy A/A plan fields against the sealed v4 design and formal baseline binary/source.

recommendation.reason: F1 and F2 make the nominal v5 path either unreducible or able to mistake helper readiness for a passing XLS safety guard; F3 leaves terminal A/A custody substitution possible. Candidate source/build/review custody and packet terminal/source validation otherwise pass.
